elements.requirement: A person (A) victimises another person (B) if person A subjects person B to a detriment because person B does a protected act.
elements.quote: A subjects B to a detriment because— (a) B does a protected act

elements.requirement: A person (A) victimises another person (B) if person A subjects person B to a detriment because person A believes that person B has done, or may do, a protected act.
elements.quote: A believes that B has done, or may do, a protected act

elements.requirement: Bringing proceedings under the Equality Act 2010 constitutes a protected act.
Giving evidence or information in connection with proceedings under the Equality Act 2010 constitutes a protected act.
elements.quote: giving evidence or information in connection with proceedings under this Act

elements.requirement: Doing any other thing for the purposes of or in connection with the Equality Act 2010 constitutes a protected act.
elements.quote: doing any other thing for the purposes of or in connection with this Act

elements.requirement: Making an allegation, whether express or not, that person A or another person has contravened the Equality Act 2010 constitutes a protected act.
elements.quote: making an allegation (whether or not express) that A or another person has contravened this Act

elements.requirement: Giving false evidence or information, or making a false allegation, does not constitute a protected act if the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, in bad faith.
elements.quote: not a protected act if the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, in bad faith

elements.requirement: The statutory rules on victimisation apply only where the person subjected to a detriment (person B) is an individual.
elements.quote: applies only where the person subjected to a detriment is an individual

elements.requirement: A reference to contravening the Equality Act 2010 includes committing a breach of an equality clause or rule.
elements.quote: includes a reference to committing a breach of an equality clause or rule
